title: A tour of the math tools
body:
## Math notation

Lessons, questions, notecards and drills can show math. Inline: the quadratic formula is $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$. On its own line:

$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx = F(b) - F(a)$$

Prices still read normally: a $250,000 home with $3,000 in costs.

## Graphs

A parabola, its tangent line at $x = 1$, and the area under it from 0 to 2:

```plot
{"x": [-3, 4], "y": [-2, 8], "functions": [{"f": "x^2 - 2x + 2", "label": "f"}], "tangents": [{"f": "x^2 - 2x + 2", "at": 1}], "shade": [{"f": "x^2 - 2x + 2", "from": 0, "to": 2}], "points": [{"at": [1, 1], "label": "vertex (1, 1)"}]}
```

Trig functions over one period:

```plot
{"x": [0, 6.3], "y": [-1.5, 1.5], "functions": [{"f": "sin(x)", "label": "sin x"}, {"f": "cos(x)", "label": "cos x", "dashed": true}]}
```

## Diagrams

```shape
{"polygons": [{"points": [[0, 0], [4, 0], [4, 3]]}], "rightAngles": [[[4, 0], [0, 0], [4, 3]]], "segments": [{"from": [0, 0], "to": [4, 0], "label": "4"}, {"from": [4, 0], "to": [4, 3], "label": "3"}, {"from": [4, 3], "to": [0, 0], "label": "5"}], "labels": [{"at": [0.8, 0.25], "text": "\u03b8"}], "caption": "A 3-4-5 right triangle"}
```

## Answering

In drills you can type math: `3/4`, `sqrt(3)/2`, `2pi`, `6.02e23`, or an expression like `3x^2 - 2` when the answer is a formula. A preview shows how it reads. Some answers take units (`25 km/h`), and fraction answers must be exact.
